name: flutter-merge-skills
description: Skills for merging another standalone Flutter project's UI code into the current host Flutter project as a self-contained feature subtree.

plugins.name: flutter-merge-into-host
plugins.description: Merges another standalone Flutter project's UI (lib/ + assets/ + pubspec deps) into the current host Flutter project. 5-phase pipeline: discover → decide → graft → adapt → verify. Triggers on Chinese phrases 迁移/flutter迁移/复制/合并 or English merge/migrate/graft (with or without a source path). Supports safe and auto modes.
